page_title: CAG 1-2 LAZ | Cagliari v Lazio 03/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+3' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
90+2' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Substitution. Antoine Makoumbou did his best and is replaced by Matteo Prati (Cagliari).
88' Substitution. Mattia Felici makes way for Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari).
87' Fabrizio Del Rosso prepares a substitution. Mattia Zaccagni is replaced by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
87' Fabrizio Del Rosso has decided to make a change. Pedro (Lazio) replaces Gustav Isaksen.
87' The game has come to an end for Boulaye Dia. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
86' The foul by Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
86' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Mattia Felici (Cagliari), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
86' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

85' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Ivan Provedel sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
83' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:11.
81' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
77' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Mattia Felici (Cagliari) inside the box.
76' The corner kick from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
76' Substitution. Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) on for Michel Adopo.
75' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Gabriele Zappa will be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).

75' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Elia Caprile thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
74' The corner by Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
73' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
73' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Elia Caprile has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
72' Some great controlled play and passing from Lazio. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nicolas Viola as he is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
66' The total number of attempts is 8:8.
64' 1 - 2 Goal! Mattia Zaccagni gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Taty Castellanos (Lazio), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 1:2.
62' Fabrizio Del Rosso is forced to make a change. Elseid Hysaj is unable to continue due to injury, Samuel Gigot (Lazio) comes on.
59' The game is interrupted now, Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
59' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) will take the corner.
58' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
58' The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.

57' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Elia Caprile leaps like a salmon to deny him.
55' 1 - 1 Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:1.
55' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) will take a corner kick.
54' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Gianluca Manganiello saw the whole situation.
53' Cagliari players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
50' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
48' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
46' The ball spins to Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is cleared to safety by the defence.
45' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
43' The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.

41' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Elseid Hysaj, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio), who beats Elia Caprile with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 0:1.
39' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
36' The game is interrupted as Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is flagged offside.
35' A spell of possession for Lazio in an attempt to control the game.
34' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
31' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul after Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
27' PENALTY APPEAL after Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
24' The linesman raises his flag. Adam Marusic (Lazio) is adjudged offside.
22' There's an opportunity for Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
22' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
19' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Lazio due to a handball in the build-up play.
18' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Lazio players aren’t happy.
16' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) scores a peculiar goal using an unorthodox part of his body.
16' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
14' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
13' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
12' A clever short pass gives Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
9' A cross from Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
7' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is penalised for a foul. Gianluca Manganiello had a clear view and blows his whistle.
7' The corner from Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is hurriedly cleared.
6' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
6' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Ivan Provedel easily deals with the threat.
4' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) was too forceful with his tackle and Gianluca Manganiello interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
4' Adam Marusic (Lazio) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
4' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
3' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The first half has started.
Lazio will kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello is introduced as the referee for today's match.
